headline.title: DuckDuckGo installs are up 30% as users reject being ‘force-fed’ Google’s AI Search
headline.summary: DuckDuckGo app installs have increased by 30% following Google's overhaul of its Search functionality, which replaced traditional links with AI agents. This surge reflects user dissatisfaction with the changes and a desire for alternatives to Google's AI-driven search.

articles.title: Did the Pope use AI to write about the dangers of AI?
articles.summary: An analysis by Linch Zhang suggests that portions of Pope Leo XIV's encyclical, Magnifica Humanitas, addressing the dangers of AI, may have been generated by AI, with the AI detector Pangram indicating that certain paragraphs were composed up to 100% by AI. This raises questions about the authenticity and authorship of the document's content.

articles.title: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
articles.summary: The MiniMax-M2 series introduces a new family of Mixture-of-Experts language models, with the flagship M2 model featuring 229.9 billion parameters and only 9.8 billion activated per token. This series is designed for agentic deployment, utilizing agent-driven data pipelines to enhance real-world intelligence.

articles.title: Tail-Aware HiFloat4: W4A4 Post-Training Quantization for Wan2.2
articles.summary: The article presents Tail-Aware HiFloat4, a novel post-training quantization method for the Wan2.2 model, aimed at improving low-bit text-to-video generation. The approach modifies the ViDiT-Q quantization pipeline by applying W4A4 HiFloat4 fake quantization to main linear layers while preserving high precision in sensitive boundary modules.

articles.title: LiveK12Bench: Have Large Multimodal Models Truly Conquered High School-level Examinations?
articles.summary: The article discusses the limitations of existing benchmarks for evaluating Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in high school-level examinations, highlighting their inability to accurately reflect real-world testing environments. It emphasizes the need for more dynamic and comprehensive datasets to fully assess the capabilities of these models as intelligent tutors.

articles.title: From Norms to Indicators (N2I-RAG): An Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Legal Indicator Computation
articles.summary: The article introduces the N2I-RAG framework, which aims to enhance the computation of legal indicators from normative texts by addressing challenges related to legal language complexity and document quality. It highlights the potential of combining natural language processing and generative models to improve legal analysis while mitigating issues like hallucinations and interpretability.

articles.title: VitaBench 2.0: Evaluating Personalized and Proactive Agents in Long-Term User Interactions
articles.summary: VitaBench 2.0 is a new benchmark designed to assess the performance of personalized and proactive agents in long-term user interactions, emphasizing the importance of understanding user intent beyond explicit communication. The framework aims to improve collaboration between large language models and users by focusing on personalized modeling and proactive engagement in real-world tasks.

articles.title: 2-ASP(Q) programs with weak constraints: Complexity and efficient implementation
articles.summary: The paper presents a detailed analysis of 2-ASP(Q)^w, a fragment of Answer Set Programming that incorporates two quantifiers and weak constraints, highlighting its capability to address optimization problems within the Delta_3^P complexity class. It also offers a comprehensive complexity characterization of the key computational tasks associated with this framework.

articles.title: AssetGen: Deployable 3D Asset Generation at Interactive Speed
articles.summary: AssetGen is a new 3D asset generation tool that prioritizes user experience and deployability, producing high-quality meshes, baked normals, and color textures from a single reference image in just 30 seconds. The generated assets are optimized for real-time rendering, making them suitable for mobile applications.

articles.title: Max-Window Scale Estimation for Near-Lossless HiF8 W8A8 Quantization-Aware Training
articles.summary: The article presents a systematic study of HiF8 W8A8 quantization-aware training (QAT) for the OpenPangu-Embedded-1B model, focusing on the impact of Delayed Tensor Scaling (DTS). Through eight controlled experiments, the authors identify and analyze two distinct failure modes related to amax saturation and scale estimation in low-bit floating-point formats.

articles.title: VesselSim: learning 3D blood vessel segmentation without expert annotations
articles.summary: VesselSim is a two-stage framework designed for 3D blood vessel segmentation that operates without requiring expert annotations, addressing a significant challenge in medical image analysis. The approach aims to enhance the development of deep learning techniques for vascular disease care and surgical planning by utilizing synthetic data for training.

articles.title: E$^3$C: Video Generation with 3D Environmental Memory and Ego-Exo Human Pose Control
articles.summary: The paper introduces E$^3$C, a novel approach for generating egocentric videos that incorporates 3D environmental memory and ego-exo human pose control. This method addresses the challenges of viewpoint changes and self-occlusions in video synthesis, enabling embodied agents to better understand and predict actions in dynamic environments.
